name: hepatocyte growth factor
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: HGF encodes hepatocyte growth factor [Cleaved into: Hepatocyte growth factor alpha chain; Hepatocyte growth factor beta chain]. Annotated molecular activities include chemoattractant activity and growth factor activity. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal recessive nonsyndromic hearing loss 39 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Small Cell Lung Cancer. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
